relations.reused_or_minted_predicate: reused (promoted renamedFrom) - in the active-active model the former Primary is stated to become the new DR cluster automatically, a role relabeling rather than a data operation
relations.evidence: The original primary becomes the new DR cluster automatically and requires no manual XDCR reconfiguration.

notable_absence.finding: For the two non-active-active DR models ('Clusters in Same Region' and 'Clusters in Different Regions'), activation involves the SAME role swap stated in near-identical language twice: 'Make the Disaster Recovery cluster the new Primary cluster, and make the old Primary cluster the new Disaster Recovery.' Unlike the active-active model's automatic swap (captured above via renamedFrom), this swap is a MANUAL administrative step in both other models - the same underlying fact (roles relabel, no data moves) recurs three times on this page under three different amounts of automation, and no page distinguishes 'automatic relabeling' from 'manual relabeling' as a named axis.

cross_component_finding: All three DR models in this page rely on the SAME optional optimization (pre-initializing/pre-building Sync Gateway's own GSI indexes on the DR cluster before failover) to avoid the exact index-rebuild latency problem this batch's indexing.md and index-partitions.md describe from the configuration side - a concrete example of index-partitions.json's Zero-Downtime migration guidance and this page's DR activation guidance solving the same underlying problem (avoiding an index rebuild on a live-traffic switch) in two different operational contexts.
cross_product_finding: Corrected during round 28 reconciliation (see concepts[] note above): this page's active-active DR model is Sync Gateway's own native sgw:bidirectional-xdcr, not xdcr:active-active-with-app-services (Capella App Services' distinct feature, gated at Server 7.6.6+/App Services 4.0+ with no Sync Gateway version dependency stated anywhere). The page names no App Services/Capella concept at all; the original 'fourth independent leg confirming the same concept from the mobile side' framing was itself the misattribution, not a genuine fourth corroborating source.
